parameters.name: TaskId
parameters.description: Job ID. For information about how to obtain the job ID, see [ListTasks](~~454662~~).

parameters.name: TenantId
parameters.description: Tenant ID. For information about how to obtain the tenant ID, see [ListTenants](~~454649~~).

parameters.name: WorkNodeId
parameters.description: Worker node ID, which corresponds to the pipeline sequence starting from 0. For example, in the sequence annotation → quality inspection → validation, annotation is 0, quality inspection is 1, and validation is 2.
